bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 63
cd "$root"
branch=chat/link-button-master-final-20261120
sha=026842b8d1a5e25d9e26a7c0ab47f75bfacf1e04
files=(scripts/userbot_link_photo_caption_smoke.py scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py scripts/userbot_link_flow_smoke.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py)
for f in "${files[@]}"; do
 git ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" >/dev/null || exit 64
 git diff --quiet HEAD -- "$f" || exit 65
 git diff --cached --quiet -- "$f" || exit 66
done
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 67
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 68
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-script-sync.XXXXXXXX)"
swapped=0
passed=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$passed" != 1; then
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do cp "$tmp/old/$f" "$root/$f" || true; done
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
for f in "${files[@]}"; do
 mkdir -p "$tmp/old/$(dirname "$f")" "$tmp/new/$(dirname "$f")"
 cp "$f" "$tmp/old/$f"
 git show FETCH_HEAD:"$f" >"$tmp/new/$f" || exit 69
done
python3 - "$tmp/new" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys
for path in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).rglob("*.py"):
 compile(path.read_bytes(),str(path),"exec")
PY
for f in "${files[@]}"; do cp "$tmp/new/$f" "$f"; done
swapped=1
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 70
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 72
passed=1
echo LINK_TEST_SCRIPT_SHA=VERIFIED
echo RESIDENT_AUTH_HEALTH=PASS
echo USERBOT_PRESERVED=PASS
